chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far عليه السلام about two women who killed a man deliberately. He said: “They shall both be killed for him; no one differs regarding this.”

key_terms.بِهِ: for him, in retaliation for his killing
key_terms.تُقْتَلَانِ: the two of them are to be killed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if two women intentionally kill one man in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on intentional homicide committed by two women against one man. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام states that both are subject to retaliation (qisas) for him, presenting the matter as undisputed in this case.
